digest.component_or_area: mutation testing gate and CI workflow
propositions: Historical mutant counts are stale; signing.py contains 814 mutants versus 491 in old record, including both equivalent survivors and contract gaps.
Mutation enforcement modes (advisory, ratchet, strict) are defined with distinct evidence requirements and failure conditions, with mode changes driven by stable pilot runs and per-shard eligibility.
Fresh base/head archives without persisted verdict cache are used for all blocking runs, with AST-identical function regression checks and explicit fingerprints for accepted equivalent survivors.

Shard selection maps changed source, test, and support files to their shards; selector emits JSON, creates per-shard matrix jobs with 30-minute caps each, and permits explicit all-shard or targeted runs.

Manifest-authoritative timeout policy pins timeout_constant=1.0 and timeout_multiplier=15.0 with per-shard explicit values, generating archive-local mutmut config without duplicate repository mapping.
